experiment: E7 anchor hardening: stall unit test (two slow-client scenarios against the earlier and the hardened anchor daemon)

environment.address: 127.0.0.1, one daemon process per run, fresh random HMAC key per run
environment.serving_limits: defaults (HOMEPROV_ANCHOR_IO_TIMEOUT_S, HOMEPROV_ANCHOR_REQUEST_DEADLINE_S and HOMEPROV_ANCHOR_MAX_BODY unset: 5 s, 10 s, 16 MiB)

original.served_by: its __main__ block: socketserver.TCPServer (one thread) with its handler H; paths redirected to a temporary directory, bound to 127.0.0.1

hardened.served_by: anchord.serve(): AnchorServer (thread per connection) with H

scenarios.flood: 16 slow clients, 4 of each kind silent, slow_headers, partial_body, trickle_body

workload.reopen: each slow client reopens its connection whenever the daemon closes it
workload.attempt_window: first attempt 1 s after the slow clients start; every attempt ends before the stall ends
workload.failed_at: connect: the connection was never accepted within the client timeout; response: the request was sent and no reply came within the client timeout
workload.late_commit: an attempt whose client saw no HTTP 200 but whose record is in the chain at the end (the daemon read and appended it after the client had given up)
workload.after_stall: 3 appends, 3 s after the slow clients stop
workload.bound_meaning: an authenticated append counts as accepted within the bound when it is answered HTTP 200 within bound_s of the request
